name: goal-d3-nested-pi
text:
import Prelude
def k (xs : List (Nat → Nat)) : Nat := by
  exact 0
note: D3 (task 26 review): a Pi nested under an application. `showGoal` covers only the top-level Pi spine, so a Pi in `List (…)`, `Eq(…)` or a Σ argument still goes through `show` and prints its binder; the host prints `Nat → Nat` there.

knownGap.reason: nested Pi outside the top-level spine (task 27): `show` prints the binder, so a Pi argument reads `(List (x1 : Nat) → Nat)` where the host has `List (Nat → Nat)`
